happened: Group Lyndsay Hurst built an AI agent that wakes on an email notification, reads client name, team name, and phone number, uses Call Transcript, CRM, and Email, matches the caller to an existing client, matches them to the representing team, logs the call in the CRM, then forwards the voicemail and summary to that team.
issue: Skills miss the warmup best board. Logging the call in the CRM is in instead of summarizing the call and what is requested.
why: Container, tools, trigger, inputs, and action are right. The CRM log is a skill instead of a summary, so the next person still does not get the ask in a form they can use.

skills: Match the caller to an existing client
Log the call in the CRM
Match the client to the Team that best represents them
board.action: Forward voicemail and a summary of the call request to the representing team
